sections: Air temperature (2 m) for the Nile corridor from 2001-01 to 2024-12, based on MERRA-2 T2M (M2TMNXSLV v5.12.4) — a reanalysis product, not direct satellite observations.

Regional mean 290.359 K over 288 monthly values (descriptive output). Inference was not computed: inferential output is not released before the method review gate passes (inference not released). No trend claim is made.
Full provenance, method settings and source hashes are available in receipt SYNTHETIC_receipt.
Annual descriptive Theil–Sen slope: 0.03125 K per year. 24 valid annual observations. Positive/negative cell slopes are not significance classifications.
QA retained 4 of 4 selected cells (100.00% of selected native-cell area). Positive slopes: 4; negative slopes: 0. No significance test was released.
